Emotion: Every interaction feels like the start of a party
Content: Events are heroes; UI is the stage
Contrast: Deepest blacks vs. blinding neons

instructions_to_main_agent: STRICTLY follow the Dark Mode requirement. No white backgrounds.
Use 'Unbounded' font for all headings to give that distinct modern techno look.
Implement the 'Bottom Navigation' for mobile views instead of a top hamburger menu for better UX.
Use the 'sonner' library for toasts (already in ui/sonner.jsx).
For the 'Countdown', use a monospace font and make it large and red/pink when under 5 minutes.
Ensure the 'QR Code' on the ticket page is high contrast (White on Black) for scanning reliability.
Use the 'glass' utility class defined in index.css for overlays.
For the 'Admin Dashboard', use a dense grid layout but keep the neon accents for active states.
Legal pages should use a single column layout with generous text spacing for readability.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic gradients. Use the specific primary gradient defined in colors.
Always add hover states to interactive elements.
Ensure touch targets are at least 44px for mobile users.
